siteTitle: Mihail Mihaylov — Film Student, Director & Editor

hero.sub: Film student at New Bulgarian University working across directing, editing, and live production.

about.lead: I'm Mihail, a film student based in Sofia, Bulgaria, currently studying Cinema and Television at New Bulgarian University.
about.p1: Over the past few years, I've had the chance to work on a variety of projects, from short films and documentaries to television productions and online video.
about.p2: I'm particularly interested in directing and editing, although I enjoy being involved in different parts of the filmmaking process. I'm still exploring my place in the industry, learning through each project and looking forward to whatever comes next.

jobs.desc: Brought on as freelance live broadcast crew alongside university colleagues for major gaming events: Vivacom Game-ON and Good Game Festival.

detail.title: TDB Play
detail.synopsis: Freelance live broadcast crew for Vivacom Game-ON and Good Game Festival. Directing on ATEM switcher software, operating Lumix on a DJI Ronin, and navigating grueling 16-hour festival sprints with fellow NBU peers.
detail.gear: Lumix, DJI Ronin, ATEM Software Control
detail.description:
I was brought on by esports and gaming agency **TDB Play** on a per-day freelance contract, working alongside several of my Cinema and Television colleagues from New Bulgarian University.

### Vivacom Game-ON: Live Vision Mixer

Vivacom Game-ON was a packed, high-energy, one-day event where I served as the live vision mixer (режисьор на пулт). My responsibilities included managing multiple camera feeds, coordinating with commentators, and communicating simultaneously with camera operators and the director while switching between live feeds.

### Good Game Festival: Camera Operator & Multi-Role Support

Good Game Festival was a much larger production, spanning over a week. I worked four full days of the festival, primarily as a live camera operator, either operating a Lumix mirrorless camera mounted on a DJI Ronin gimbal stabilizer or capturing events from a tripod.

Moving throughout the large venue, we covered stage performances, esports matches, and an incredible live concert featuring orchestral arrangements of iconic video game soundtracks. Whenever the live control desk needed additional support, I stepped back in on the switcher or helped wherever the production crew needed an extra pair of hands.

The biggest challenge was the sheer physical and mental endurance required, with 16-hour shifts running from 8:00 in the morning until midnight. Operating a heavy gimbal rig for hours while maintaining precise framing and staying attentive to live broadcast cues was demanding.

What made the experience not just manageable, but genuinely memorable and enjoyable, was the team. The TDB Play crew was incredibly supportive, organised, and collaborative. Having my university colleagues working right alongside me also made those marathon shifts fly by.

jobs.desc: Sole video specialist owning the full pipeline - cinematography, lighting, sound, edit and DaVinci grade - delivering high-volume content for 7Arts, ArtPortal and Art Label productions.

detail.title: 7Arts
detail.synopsis: Independently managing the video pipeline, handling shooting, lighting, sound, and editing. I produced a high volume of trailers, social reels, and promos across their streaming platform, news division, and theatre productions.
detail.description:
Although initially brought on as an editor, I operated as the company's sole video production specialist, managing the entire pipeline from set to final export. I independently handled all cinematography, lighting, and sound recording, followed by cutting and color grading in DaVinci Resolve. I delivered a high volume of content tailored to three distinct branches of the company:

7Arts (Streaming Platform): Shot and edited promotional trailers for the platform itself, alongside dedicated trailers and social marketing reels for individual films and shows.

ArtPortal: Handled the end-to-end production of a massive catalog of short-form reels for the arts and news website, successfully translating written articles into engaging, fast-paced video content.

Art Label Productions & The Big Praz Show: Filmed and crafted dynamic announcement videos for upcoming theatre productions and edited high-energy promotional advertisements for The Big Praz Show.

jobs.desc: Two internships - Production Intern in 2022 and Video Editing Intern in 2025, cutting Deroni recipe videos and Уча, зная и играя episodes.

detail.title: Timeless Production Group Ltd
detail.synopsis: Two internships - from Production Intern in 2022 to Video Editing Intern in 2025, cutting Deroni recipe videos and Уча, зная и играя.
detail.description:
Video Editing Intern - February 2025 – April 2025

Returning to the company for a second internship, I stepped directly into an active editing role. During this three-month period, I was trusted to cut commercial YouTube content for clients, specifically focusing on fast-paced, short-form recipe videos featuring Deroni products. Additionally, I took on broadcast responsibilities by editing several episodes of the children's educational television program Уча, зная и играя.

Production Intern - July 2022 – September 2022

During my initial time with the company, I focused on absorbing as much as possible about how a professional production environment operates. I assisted the team with general, day-to-day tasks, doing the foundational, hands-on work required to keep a production moving while learning the industry ropes from the ground up.
